issue.title: Enhancement: Fix Lossy case flakiness on Cisco G200 platforms

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

There is background lossy traffic which impact egress lossy pool availability, which makes G200 lossy drop trigger flaky.

### Current Behavior

Hard-coded -40 for lossy_drop_tuning_pkts.

### Proposed Behavior

Generate lossy_drop_tuning_pkts in runtime.

resolution.title: Adjust lossy pkts_num for cisco gr2 by subtracting egress_lossy_pool base watermark
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25958

Fix Lossy case flakiness on Cisco G200 platforms.
Single lossy queue drop threshold of G200 is 46MB when pool availability > 34 MB.
egress lossy pool size is 80 MB, 80 - 46 = 34 MB, which makes the lossy queue drop trigger is at the boundary of pool availability.
When there is background lossy traffic which accounted in egress lossy pool, it will trigger target lossy queue drop a little bit earlier than queue occupancy 46MB. Use egress lossy pool base watermark as background lossy traffic memory usage, and subtract it from 46MB. Expected_lossy_drop_trigger = 46 MB - egress_lossy_pool_watermark_base.

#### How did you do it?
